title: Presio plugin manifest (v2)
description: presio-plugin.json, served next to the plugin's HTML. The plugin's id is not declared here: it comes from where the plugin is loaded from (github:alice/presio-poll is alice/poll). Validated by shared/plugin/manifest.ts; see /plugins.md.

presio.description: The plugin API's major version the plugin is written for. Additive API changes keep it; a breaking change is a new major.

name.description: A slug. The id's name part where the source doesn't give one (a plugin served from a URL: url:<host>/<name>).

displayName.description: What people see; name by default.

version.description: Semver. Released under the git tag "v" + version.

main.description: The plugin's HTML, relative to the manifest.

surfaces.description: background: hidden on the presenter's device; handles commands and keeps state. panel: inside the presenter's dashboard cards, one per contributes.panels entry. viewerSheet: a bottom sheet (phones) or side card on audience devices, shown while the plugin asks (presio.ui.setVisible) and until the viewer closes it. viewer: a full-screen layer on every viewer screen, hidden until the plugin shows it. slide: a layer over the slide itself, on the presenter's current slide and every viewer; lets input through unless the plugin claims it.

slideSurface.description: What the slide surface covers. page: the page itself, so fractions of the layer are page positions. area: the whole slide area around it, letterbox bars included; presio.ui.page says where the page is within it.

activation.description: When the plugin runs: "always", or "attachment:<glob>" for decks embedding a matching attachment.

permissions.description: deck: read the PDF (its bytes, attachments, page sizes). editDeck: save an edited PDF over the deck (presenter's device only). history: an edit history for the deck shared with every device, and blobs. audience: collect each viewer's input (presio.audience).

dependencies.description: Other plugins this one needs: source ("github:alice/presio-quiz-core", or the alice/quiz-core shorthand) → semver range ("^1.0.0", "~1.2.0", "1.x", ">=1.2.0", "1.2.3").

commands.description: What the plugin can do. Handled with presio.commands.register(id, handler); run by its buttons and keybindings, and by other plugins as presio.commands.execute("<plugin id>.<id>", args).

location.description: controller.toolbar: the bottom bar. controller.currentSlide: the current slide card's header, as an icon. thumbnail.context: a thumbnail's context menu; the command gets { slide }. viewer.toolbar: every audience device's toolbar; the command runs in that device's viewerSheet, viewer or slide frame. settings: the plugin's page in Settings.

accept.description: Ask the presenter for a file of these types (an <input accept> value) first; the command runs with { file }.

buttons.description: Buttons Presio draws that run a command. Their state (active, label, disabled, a menu) is set with presio.ui.setButton(command, state); a menu pick runs the command with { menuItem }.

keybindings.description: Default keys for commands on the presenter's controller, rebindable in Settings (stored as "<plugin id>.<command>" in the keybindings setting). Presio's own shortcuts win where keys overlap. An empty keys list makes the command bindable without a default.

status.description: Small text Presio shows for the plugin ("12 votes"), set at runtime with presio.ui.setStatus; hidden until then.

panels.description: Cards on the presenter's dashboard, each showing the plugin's panel surface (presio.panel is the id). Needs "panel" in surfaces.

settings.description: Settings stored as "<plugin id>.<name>" in the presenter's settings file.
